# Intelligent Computing Systems Laboratory

Official website of the Intelligent Computing Systems Laboratory (ICSLab), School of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC).

## English

- [Home](https://www.nise.ac.cn/): Laboratory overview, research areas and representative projects
- [News](https://www.nise.ac.cn/news): Research and publication updates
- [People](https://www.nise.ac.cn/people): Faculty, research assistants and students
- [Publications](https://www.nise.ac.cn/publication): Selected research publications
- [Contact](https://www.nise.ac.cn/contact): Admissions, collaboration and contact information

## 简体中文

- [主页](https://www.nise.ac.cn/zh/): 实验室简介、研究方向与代表性项目
- [动态](https://www.nise.ac.cn/zh/news): 科研与论文动态
- [人员](https://www.nise.ac.cn/zh/people): 教师、科研助理与学生
- [论文](https://www.nise.ac.cn/zh/publication): 精选科研论文
- [联系我们](https://www.nise.ac.cn/zh/contact): 招生、合作与联系方式
